name: vs-chromium
description: Instant indexed code search for very large source trees (e.g. Chromium), powered by the VsChromium indexing server.

vschromium.serverPath.description: Path to VsChromium.Server.exe. Leave empty to use the server bundled with the extension (or, during development, the one in Binaries\Debug of the vs-chromium repository).

vschromium.trace.server.description: Log all messages exchanged with the indexing server to the VsChromium output channel.

vschromium.searchCode.maxResults.description: Maximum number of matches returned by Search Code. Higher values may slow down the user interface.

vschromium.searchCode.maxExtractLength.description: Maximum number of characters displayed per line in Search Code results.

vschromium.searchCode.autoSearchDelayMs.description: Time (in milliseconds) to wait after typing before searching (Search Code and Find File Names). For Search Code, takes effect when the Code Search view is reopened.

vschromium.searchFilePaths.maxResults.description: Maximum number of files returned by Find File Names.

vschromium.trigramFilters.description: Use trigram filters for the projects of the workspace: faster code searches, at the cost of memory (about 5% of the size of the indexed file contents).

scripts.package: node scripts/copy-server.js Release win32-x64 && vsce package --target win32-x64
scripts.package:linux-x64: node scripts/copy-server.js Release linux-x64 && vsce package --target linux-x64
scripts.package:linux-arm64: node scripts/copy-server.js Release linux-arm64 && vsce package --target linux-arm64
scripts.package:darwin-arm64: node scripts/copy-server.js Release darwin-arm64 && vsce package --target darwin-arm64
scripts.package:win32-arm64: node scripts/copy-server.js Release win32-arm64 && vsce package --target win32-arm64
scripts.package:debug: node scripts/copy-server.js Debug win32-x64 && vsce package --target win32-x64
